meta_description:
2,760 likes, 18 comments - cntraveler on October 28, 2026: "Salem, Massachusetts turns 400 this year, and the festivities this fall (and for Halloween!) are expected to be even more extravagant. Famous for its 17th-century witch trials, the city has gained a reputation for haunted thrills, offering museums that let guests explore the infamous history as well as more upbeat Halloween-themed events all October long.

Whether you're strolling through its haunted streets, captured here by @magicinsalem, or immersing yourself in the history of the witch trials, Salem offers an unforgettable journey into the past. At the link in bio @jamie.spain and @pariwils share their guide to visiting Salem this Halloween season, including where to eat, stay, and play while you're in town.".
